title: MZ Hajime's Day Out | Pokemon Visual Novel

posts.author: Reversalius
posts.body:
Hajime's Day Out!
​
SECTION A: SYNOPSIS
Spoiler
Follow Hajime Astrid as he goes about a day of his summer break, perhaps he could spend it with one of his siblings? Such as his sister Amelia, an artist that values nature, his brother Irving, a protective lifeguard, Ace, a electric Greaser, or Josie, a fiery Punk.
The gameplay is mainly a Visual Novel, with slight additions here and there, with some minigames to entertain the player while progressing the story
The story features five possible endings depending on the choices and decisions of the player
IMAGES/SCREENSHOTS
Spoiler
SECTION B: CHARACTERS
Spoiler
Hajime Astrid: An Eevee, Someone who is uncertain about his own path in life, feeling that his path lies in being popular or at the very least, well-liked by others. At first, he simply imitated his siblings to get this feeling, but it evolved into doing anything that he believed would get him the validation he wished. Though one day he might end up looking back on these days, wishing to return to them.
Amelia Astrid: An artist Leafeon, widely recognized for her craft, she mainly does paintings of nature. She tends to see the best in others, trying to help them reach their potential.
Ace Astrid: A greaser Jolteon with a smoking problem that he has yet to shake off, He's rather carefree aside from that, with him usually being found flirting with women both on and off the clock at the diner.
Josie Astrid: A Punk Flareon, not exactly one for authority and control. She is kind towards her friends and family though sarcastic to most everyone, and doesn't exactly care what anyone says about her.
Irving Astrid: A Lifeguard Vaporeon, not the smartest but he is friendly and quite strong. He's always enjoyed the ocean, having a connection with it. He's supportive of others, especially his family.
Feel free to give ideas, I accept Feedback and critique. This project is mainly a sort of "Test run" for me creating games in the RPG MAKER MZ engine. Originally was gonna use Renpy but RPG MAKER is a far easier program to use in my opinion.

posts.body:
PKMN:HDO - Dev Log #1
​
Welp! First time doing one of these sorts of things, but hey! Giving it a try!
So, I've made progress on quite a few of the map outlines for the game, with only one left unsketched for the time being. About to work on the proper story scripting, as I have been working off of my old basic outlines for my tests with the starting area.
Currently, I still need to figure out what to do for Josie's Route, planning to make it a way to test a feature of RPG MAKER MZ, so I can use it more effectively for further projects. I welcome suggestions for whatever might be a good thing to test!

posts.author: Reversalius
posts.body:
PKMN:HDO - Dev Log #2
​
Alright! So I've made some progress despite some minor procrastination (Was playing a game for like 3 days, and painting swords) As I get more and more through the coding process of the game, the game will likely be short in terms of the routes unfortunately. But hey! Better to make a good short game rather than a boring, long game? RIght?
Anyways, mainly been making progress on the opening part of the game. I am now getting into the routes of the game, and I realize I should probably make each of the routes have a sort of minigame to go with it in order to make it so each route has something to it that isn't simply the character you chose to spend the day with.
Likely gonna end up with a painting minigame for one of them and a swimming minigame for the other! Gotta figure out the minigames for the other routes, though I feel that it'll end up being simpler than even I think it'll be!
To end, here's how one of the rooms are coming along for the game!
